## Input
**Ships with `useSyntheticData` ON, so it runs with no credentials and no data tables.**
Hit Execute and you should get verdict SUSPECT, fingerprint a834ed58f0de4b1e.

Set `useSyntheticData` to false in Config to point it at a real execution_id on your own
instance - that path needs an n8n API credential and the recorder_evidence_packs table.
It reads the execution record, which is where the real tool calls survive even when memory
and log streaming drop them (n8n-io/n8n #14361, #28532).

## Ledger, then reconciliation
Rebuild what the agent ACTUALLY did, then compare it with what the agent SAID it did. Secrets are masked before anything is stored.

## Seal, store, alert
One pack per examination, keyed on execution + fingerprint. Re-checking an execution and reaching a different verdict appends a row rather than being blocked. CLEAN is unreachable when the record is partial or missing.
